Provide the IPC of the invention (I) and the nationality information of the first applicant. 1XML file is all the information of the invention patent application. 2. The data set contains the following files: (1) The folder named in the first three codes of the application number is: 104\PatentApplI_104121827.xml (2)PatentApplI_application number.xml such as: PatentApplI_104121827 .xml (3)PatentApplI.dtd [dtd definition file, download DTD specification file at the bottom of the page] (4)index.xml [Index Information] File Type XML、Web API Field Description The information includes patent application information (application number, application date, first applicant's nationality, publication or note of public disclosure), IPC classification information (IPC classification number, IPC main department, IPC main category, IPC subclass, IPC main item, IPC sub-project, IPC version) and other itmes. Renew Frequency It is updated on the 6th, 16th, and 26th of every month according to gazette volume number. 选择你的 AI 助手 约 1 分钟完成，配置过程中不需要填写任何账号或密钥。 [Button: WorkBuddy][Button: 豆包工作][Button: 千问办公][Button: Trae][Button: Cherry Studio][Button: 其他客户端] WorkBuddy腾讯 1. 左侧进入「专家 · 技能 · 连接器」，切到上方「连接器」。 2. 点右上角「自定义连接器」→「配置 MCP」，粘贴下方配置并保存。 3. 在「我的 MCP」里确认 veyip 已启用，工具列表能展开即接入成功。 配置[Button: 复制配置] { "mcpServers": { "veyip": { "url": "https://www.veyip.com/api/mcp" } } } 本服务无需登录授权，也不用填写任何密钥。 各客户端界面会随版本调整，菜单名称以实际界面为准。 ## 接好后这样问 不用记工具名，直接用中文提问；想确保调用本服务，可在问题前加「用惟专查一下」。 * 10 月 8 日收到发明专利审查意见通知书，最晚哪天要答复？`calculate_ip_deadline` * 做动力电池热管理的发明，可以去哪些保护中心走预审？`find_protection_centers` * 小微企业申请一件发明专利，官费大概多少？`estimate_fee` * 产品在展会上公开了，三个月后还能申请专利吗？`search_regulations` * 商标注册要经过哪些阶段，大概多久能拿证？`get_trademark_process` ## 能做什么 功能 | 工具名 --- | --- 检索行业资讯 | search_news 获取资讯全文 | get_news 法规与指南目录 | list_regulations * 高校 IP 中心 辅导师生「公开后还能不能申请」、查指南原文，并给出可点击的页面链接。 ## 平台不支持 MCP？ 期限、年费、官费等确定性能力另提供只读 HTTP 接口，返回 JSON，可配置为扣子、百炼等平台的插件或工作流 HTTP 节点。 * GET https://www.veyip.com/api/cms/ip/deadline?kind=invention_oa_reply&startDate=YYYY-MM-DD · calculate_ip_deadline * GET https://www.veyip.com/api/cms/ip/deadlines · list_common_deadlines * GET https://www.veyip.com/api/cms/ip/annuity?patentType=invention · get_annuity_brackets * GET https://www.veyip.com/api/cms/ip/trademark-process · get_trademark_process * GET https://www.veyip.com/api/cms/ip/fee-estimate?service=patent_invention&feeReduction=single · estimate_fee * GET https://www.veyip.com/api/cms/resources/faq · search_faq * GET https://www.veyip.com/api/cms/protection-centers?industry= · find_protection_centers ## 数据边界与免责 * 除「提交咨询需求」外均为只读工具。提交咨询仅在用户明确同意后进行，由代理师电话联系；提交不构成委托，委托以书面合同为准。 * 费用预估只计算官费；代理费不在线公布，由代理师根据案情书面报价。 * 资讯按匿名访客输出：草稿不可见，会员专享仅提供摘要。不提供专利查新检索与智能咨询对话。 * 本服务提供中国知识产权公开信息检索、一般性期限与费用参考，不构成法律意见或代理委托。个案以国家知识产权局通知书及最新法律法规为准；委托与收费以书面合同为准。 ## 更新记录 v1.4.0 2026-10-11 * 新增 search_patents：用 PatentHub 检索式免费检索中国 / 全球专利，由惟专代为调用，访客无需 Token，按 IP 每日限次 * 新增 get_patent：按专利号或申请号读取权利要求、说明书、著录项目与法律状态，长文本分段续读 * 供 WorkBuddy「惟专知产顾问」专家做专利查新与专利挖掘 历史版本 * v1.3.0 2026-10-11 * 新增 estimate_fee：按官方收费标准计算专利、商标常见业务官费（含费减）；代理费不在线公布，提示人工报价 * 新增 submit_consultation：经用户明确同意后提交咨询需求，代理师电话联系并书面报价（唯一的写入工具，有频率限制） * 提示模板 fee_and_engagement：费用预估到委托咨询 * 只读 REST：/api/cms/ip/fee-estimate * v1.2.0 2026-10-11 * 新增 get_annuity_brackets 专利年费档位、list_common_deadlines 常见期限表、get_trademark_process 商标流程 * 场景提示模板：oa_reply_deadline / novelty_grace_check / trademark_filing_guide * 公开目录增加场景包；/.well-known/mcp.json 便于自动发现 * 确定性工具同时提供只读 REST（/api/cms/ip/*），供不支持 MCP 的平台调用 * v1.1.0 2026-10-11 * 新增 calculate_ip_deadline 法定期限计算 * search_regulations 支持口语→法律术语扩展 * get_firm_info 咨询链接带 src=mcp 便于转化统计 * 公开用量统计与空结果补库工作流 * v1.0.0 2026-10-10 * 公开只读 MCP：资讯、法规、保护中心、FAQ、分类号、机构信息 * Streamable HTTP 无状态 JSON；提示模板 ip_consultation / patent_fast_track -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 專利商標開放資料下載網站-API-專利改請案 (https://cloud.tipo.gov.tw/S220/opdata/detail/API06) 【turn156622search3】 [wordlim: 200] Crawled: 2 weeks ago; # Patent change request Instruction Open materials can be obtained by means of URLs, including the original application number, patent category, application case number, and related application categories. An MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that gives AI agents access to patent data — CN patents with CPC-aware correction, plus US/WO global coverage. Runs locally on your machine. No external API, no subscription. Always MIT. ## Why Self-Deployed * It's just Python. Install it, your agent uses it. No server to maintain, no credential to share. * No API key for 80% of use cases. Patent details and claims come straight from Google Patents public pages. * Your data stays local. Nothing leaves your machine except the same HTTP requests a browser would make. * BigQuery search is optional. Only turn it on if you need full-text search across 1.4B records. ## 30-Second Install pip install deeparchi-patent-mcp Or from source: git clone https://github.com/deeparchi-ai/patent-mcp-server.git cd patent-mcp-server pip install -e . -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 專利商標開放資料下載網站-首頁 (https://cloud.tipo.gov.tw/S220/opdata?QryDS=H01) 【turn156622search11】 [wordlim: 200] Crawled: last week; ImageOpen patent and trademark data websites of other nationsSitemapIntellectual Property OfficeImage中文 已前往 專利商標開放資料下載網站-首頁 # Patent & Trademark Open Data Downloads Invention disclosure gazette and specificationPatent publication gazette and specificationPatent rights and related casesTrademark gazetteTrademark rights and related casesAPI service View All Datasets Latest Data 1 Patent rights and related cases2026-10-162 Patent publication gazette2026-10-133 Patent publication specification2026-10-134 Trademark rights and related cases2026-10-065 Invention disclosure gazette2026-10-05 Data Statistics Update：2026-10-16 Trademark right 2,745,297 psc Image Patent right 1,899,606 psc Image Trademark gazette 1,092,696 psc Image Patent and specification 897,993 psc Invention and specification 659,652 psc Latest News View all Trademark Open Data Format Modification Notice 2022-08-24 Download Guide View all We use FTP download mode, recommend to read the following documents first：Software operation instruction API verification code applicationDOCXODT Image: Patent & Trademark Open Data Downloads The information provided is for value-added purposes only and should not be used as a basis for approval/rejection. This post explains what's changing and why.#3197 Copy link ## Description smk011001 opened on Aug 4, 2026 Issue body actions As part of MCP joining the Linux Foundation under the Agentic AI Foundation, we're updating our licensing to better align with LF project standards. This post explains what's changing and why. ## What's changing New code and specification contributions will be licensed under Apache License 2.0, and documentation contributions (excluding specifications) will be under CC-BY 4.0. Existing contributions remain under MIT. ## Why Apache 2.0 Apache 2.0 is the standard license for most Linux Foundation projects. It includes an explicit patent grant, which gives downstream users clearer protection and is often preferred by organizations contributing to or adopting open source projects. ## What this means for you * If you've already contributed: Nothing changes for your existing contributions. They remain under MIT. * If you're making new contributions: Your work will be licensed under Apache 2.0 (code/specs) or CC-BY 4.0 (docs). * If you're redistributing MCP: Include the MIT, Apache 2.0 license texts and a reference to CC-BY 4.0. ## Timeline We'll be updating the LICENSE and CONTRIBUTING files across all MCP repositories over the coming weeks. See this PR for an example of the changes. ## Questions? Feel free to reply to this discussion if you have questions or concerns!
